purpose: Form RSC-2 is used by the Tribunal to give notice to the Central Government, Registrar of Companies, and the Securities and Exchange Board of India to seek their representations and objections regarding a reduction of share capital.
when: Within fifteen days of submission of the application under rule 2, the Tribunal shall give notice.
steps: Submit the application under rule 2 to the Tribunal.
Tribunal issues Form RSC-2 to the Central Government and Registrar of Companies for all cases.
Tribunal issues Form RSC-2 to the Securities and Exchange Board of India in the case of listed companies.
checklist: Verify if the company is a listed company to determine if Form RSC-2 goes to the Securities and Exchange Board of India.
Ensure the application under rule 2 has been submitted to the Tribunal.
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
